description: This PHP script handles rescheduling of calls within the SuiteCRM system. It retrieves user inputs, adjusts call start times based on user settings, updates call details in the database, and records the rescheduling reason.

classes.name: Calls_Reschedule
classes.description: Represents the call reschedule record, including reason and call ID.

classes.name: Call
classes.description: Represents a call record with properties like date_start, date_end, duration, and methods to retrieve and save call data.

classes.name: TimeDate
classes.description: Handles date and time formatting, merging, and retrieval of user-specific time settings.

methods.name: retrieve
methods.description: Fetches call data based on ID.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Saves the current call object to the database.

methods.name: get_user_time_format
methods.description: Returns the time format string based on user preferences.

methods.name: merge_time_meridiem
methods.description: Merges time with AM/PM designation based on user settings.

methods.name: get_time_format
methods.description: Returns the system's time format string.
